note: Real source-image editing with exact prompts and recipe/input/output checksums. COS objects were verified with complete GET/SHA-256 reads before registration. Public media availability awaits the separate website release.

images.prompt: One coral-red ceramic mug beside a small green pear on a plain pale cream table, complete side silhouettes and clear separation in soft daylight. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The separate coral mug and green pear have clear complete silhouettes, a visible handle opening and natural surfaces suitable for a counted-stitch transformation.

images.actual_source_analysis: One large coral-red ceramic mug stands on the left of a pale cream tabletop, with a complete left loop handle, open oval rim and bright glaze reflections. A smaller green-yellow pear with a bent brown stem stands separately on the right. Soft daylight from the right casts coherent shadows toward the left on an empty warm cream background; no writing or extra objects.
